service.description: For the framework's post-receive gitECA rule (Git.gitecas.xml): queue the push pipelines of each branch that moved and the tag pipelines of each tag created, at their new commits, as the user who pushed, and keep the schedules of the default branch (GitPipelineSchedule). Nothing when the engine is off here (git-ci enabled; with it empty, no enabled GitRunnerPool) or the commit has no ci.xml and no component.xml.

parameter.name: refUpdates
parameter.description: As org.moqui.GitServices.process#GitEca's

parameter.name: runList
parameter.description: Maps: pipelineRunId, runNum, pipelineName, statusId (queued, waiting or error)

service.description: For the service ECA rule on queue#MergeRequestEvent (GitCi.secas.xml): queue the merge-request pipelines of a merge request that was opened, reopened, made ready or whose head moved (synchronize), at its head commit, for its target branch. A fork's or a pushed-for-review merge request's run is untrusted; a hidden one's run is hidden with it.
Queue the schedule pipelines whose cron came due since they were last checked (the queue_ScheduledPipelineRuns_frequent ServiceJob). One that fails is logged and the others still run.

Start queued job runs, oldest first, up to each pool's maxConcurrent: a container through the pool's host type, with the server's URL and a job token (the start_QueuedJobRuns_frequent ServiceJob; a run is also started soon after it is queued). A job with no pool, an image its pool does not allow or a host that does not start it is an error. Jobs of a pool of registered runners wait for a runner.

End the job runs past their time limit, the ones whose runner is gone (its container lost or exited with no result) and the queued ones no runner took, then remove from each host the containers of this server whose job run is not running (the end_OverdueJobRuns_frequent ServiceJob).

The retention of run data (the expire_PipelineRunData_daily ServiceJob): artifacts, reports and caches past their expireDate that are not kept, the logs of jobs that ended more than git-ci log-retention-days ago, and log chunks an ended job left. gc#ContentBlobs then deletes the blobs.
The runs of a repository the caller may view, newest first.

parameter.name: refName
parameter.description: A full ref (refs/heads/main)

parameter.name: includeHidden
parameter.description: With authorization disabled: the runs of hidden merge requests too

parameter.name: runList
parameter.description: Maps: pipelineRunId, repositoryId, runNum, pipelineName, definitionSource, event, refName, commitId, mergeRequestId, sourceRepositoryId, triggeredByUserId, ownerId, trusted, protectedRef, hidden, approvalState, approvedByUserId, statusId, statusMessage, environmentId, retryOfRunId, createdDate, startedDate, finishedDate, durationSeconds

service.description: A run with its jobs, in the order needs gives.

parameter.name: repositoryId
parameter.description: With runNum, in place of pipelineRunId

parameter.name: includeSuperseded
parameter.description: The attempts a retry replaced too

parameter.name: jobList
parameter.description: Maps: jobRunId, pipelineRunId, jobName, matrixKey, attempt, superseded, needs (List), context, poolName, runnerPoolId, runnerId, image, statusId, statusMessage, exitCode, timeoutMinutes, logBytes, hasLog, minutesUsed, testCount, testFailedCount, commitStatusId, queuedDate, startedDate, finishedDate, durationSeconds

parameter.name: canUpdate
parameter.description: The caller may cancel, retry and approve

service.description: A job run with its steps, its failed tests and its artifacts and reports.

parameter.name: stepList
parameter.description: Maps: stepSeq, stepName, command, statusId, exitCode, firstChunkSeq, startedDate, finishedDate, durationSeconds

parameter.name: failedTestList
parameter.description: Maps: testSeq, suiteName, testName, filePath, lineNumber, message, durationMillis

parameter.name: artifactList
parameter.description: Maps: artifactId, jobRunId, artifactKind (artifact or report), name, path, sizeBytes, sha256, keep, expireDate, createdDate, fileName

service.description: A piece of a job's log. While the job runs: the chunks after afterChunkSeq. Once it has ended (finished): the stored log from offset, as text. A page that tails passes back nextChunkSeq and nextOffset each time, so it loses no line when the job ends; with watch the caller is told of new lines on the notification topic GitCiJobLog (message: jobRunId, nextChunkSeq, finished) for a few minutes after each read.

parameter.name: chunkList
parameter.description: Maps: chunkSeq, stepSeq, text

service.description: An artifact (a tar.gz) or a report of a run and a piece of its content, maxBytes from offset, so a download is read in pieces. A cache is not found.
Run a pipeline that has the manual event for a branch or a tag, as the caller. Needs the update right on the repository. The application's run check is asked, as for every run.

parameter.name: refName
parameter.description: A branch name or a full ref; the default branch when empty

service.description: A new run of the same pipeline for the same commit and event, as the caller. A run that was untrusted for where its commits came from stays untrusted. Needs the update right.

Cancel a run that has not ended: its waiting and queued jobs are cancelled, its running jobs ended and their containers removed. Needs the update right, or to be the user who asked for the run. A run that has ended is an error.

Run an ended job again in its run, with the run's trust: a new attempt is queued, the jobs skipped for it wait again, and the old attempt is superseded. Needs the update right. A job that still runs is an error.

parameter.name: jobRunId
parameter.description: The new attempt

service.description: Let a run that waits for approval start (an untrusted run, or one the application's run check held). Needs the update right on the repository, or authorization disabled: an application with roles of its own checks them and calls this with authorization disabled. The run stays untrusted: no secrets, no cache writes, an untrusted pool. A run that does not wait is an error.
The runner pools, each with the jobs running and queued in it.

parameter.name: poolList
parameter.description: Maps: runnerPoolId, poolName, description, ownerId, instanceHostId, poolKind, trusted, enabled, maxConcurrent, allowedImages, cpuLimit, memoryMb, diskMb, pidsLimit, maxMinutes, egressRule, serverUrl, hasRegistrationToken, runningCount, queuedCount

service.description: Make or change a runner pool. A new one is named default, of containers, trusted, enabled, one job at a time, and allows no image until allowedImages names some.

parameter.name: poolKind
parameter.description: container or registered

parameter.name: trusted
parameter.description: false: the pool takes untrusted runs, and only those

service.description: Remove a pool that has no running job, with its registered runners.
A new registration token for a pool of registered runners, replacing the one it had. It is stored hashed and shown once.
The secrets of a repository (the caller needs the update right) or of an owner (authorization disabled), without their values.

parameter.name: secretList
parameter.description: Maps: secretId, name, scope, environmentId, environmentName, createdByUserId, createdDate, lastUsedDate

service.description: Make a secret or change one. The value is encrypted, written here and never read back; left out on a change, it stays. A name taken in the same scope is an error.

parameter.name: scope
parameter.description: protected (the default), tags or environment

service.description: The environments of a repository the caller may view, or of an owner (authorization disabled).

parameter.name: environmentList
parameter.description: Maps: environmentId, name, targetUrl, requiredPipeline, approvalRequired, hasToken, lastCommitId, lastDeployDate

service.description: Make or change an environment of a repository (the update right) or of an owner (authorization disabled). The target's token is encrypted and never read back. The target, the required pipeline and the approval are kept for deployments (plans/Dogfood.md §8.6), which are not built yet.
Remove an environment; refused while a secret is scoped to it.
The runner time of a repository (the caller views it) or of an owner (authorization disabled) in a month, from the GitRunnerUsage rows written as job runs end, for an application's quota.

parameter.name: periodKey
parameter.description: yyyy-MM (UTC); this month when empty

service.description: Remove every run of a repository with its jobs, steps, logs, artifacts, failures, usage, secrets, environments and schedules, for an application that deletes the repository (delete#GitRepository does not know these rows). Running jobs are cancelled first. Needs the delete right, or authorization disabled.

What the service the conf names (git-ci run-check-service) implements: asked, with authorization disabled, before a run is queued, so the application can refuse it or hold it (a quota, pipelines turned off), say an untrusted run may start without approval, lower its trust, and name whose secrets and usage it counts under. With no service, or no decision, a trusted run is allowed and an untrusted one waits. An error it leaves refuses the run with that message.

parameter.name: trusted
parameter.description: The engine's answer

parameter.name: decision
parameter.description: allow, wait (for approve#PipelineRun) or refuse

parameter.name: trusted
parameter.description: false lowers the engine's answer; true never raises it

parameter.name: message
parameter.description: Shown on the run and its statuses when it waits or is refused

parameter.name: runnerPoolId
parameter.description: The pool the run's jobs use, in place of the one their pool attribute names; it must still take the run's trust

service.description: What the service the conf names (git-ci run-url-service) implements: the page of a run, for the target of its jobs' commit statuses. With no service the conf's run-url template is used.
